newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics jump on Jan-Sept results.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics jump on Jan-Sept results.

text.p: Taiwan's blue-chip electronics shares were higher at mid-morning on Friday following the release of sound sector-wide profit results over the first nine months, brokers said.
After 90 minutes, First International Computer was up T$1.6, or 4.06 percent, to T$41 and Taiwan Semiconductor advanced T$1.5, or 2.83 percent, to T$54.5.
"Electronics' good performance strengthens investor's confidence," said Chen Han-chung, an analyst of Yungli Securities.
Many electronics firms have said they expected to do better in the fourth quarter because it is traditionally a strong business period. -- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)
